title: Tree speculation
brief: Build a tree attention mask, verify several candidates per node without changing the output distribution, choose the best tree under a node budget, and set the draft length from batch load.
hints: mask[i, j] is True when j is i or an ancestor of i. A lower-triangular mask lets a node see its earlier siblings.
A node's position id is the committed length plus its depth, not its index in the array.
Try the candidates in order. After each rejection replace the target with the normalized positive part of p - q, and keep q the same.
A node's path probability is its parent's times its edge acceptance. Expected accepted length is the sum over non-root nodes.
Pick nodes by path probability, not edge acceptance. A child never beats its parent, so the greedy pick is always a connected tree.
Each node's recurrent state starts from its parent's state. One shared state advanced in index order mixes sibling branches.
